goal: Abstain when a positive model relation lacks an explicit local connector; retain literal evidence and all rejected predictions
experiment: One fixed same-sentence directional-connector rule; no threshold search, training, label edits or reserved-test access
abstentionMeaning: No emitted edge, not NO_RELATION and not a proven false relation
evidenceMeaning: Lexical support window, not independently verified semantics or calibrated probability
fullPipelineScope: Only the historical 7 fully resolved exposed development documents; all reference positives remain in recall denominator
supplementScope: NER on 7 BIO-complete documents; conditional RE on 88 resolved reference pairs; unknowns masked and coverage disclosed. No complete-document pipeline score
